merge_behavior: Matching hooks from multiple files all run.
Multiple matching command hooks for the same event are launched concurrently, so one hook cannot prevent another matching hook from starting.
Non-managed command hooks must be reviewed and trusted before they run.
Project-local hooks load only when the project .codex/ layer is trusted.

events.name: SessionStart
events.description: Bootstrap session context or run lightweight environment checks when a Codex session starts, resumes, or clears.
events.matcher_guidance: Match the `source` field. Current values are `startup`, `resume`, and `clear`. `*` and an empty matcher both mean match all.
events.output_guidance: Plain text stdout is added as extra developer context. JSON can return common output fields and `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext`.
events.blocking_guidance: There is no dedicated block shape for this event. Keep it lightweight and context-oriented.

events.name: SubagentStart
events.description: Bootstrap subagent-specific context when Codex starts a subagent.
events.matcher_guidance: Match the `agent_type` field. Use this for subagent profile-specific bootstrap context.
events.output_guidance: Plain text stdout is added as extra developer context for the subagent. JSON can return `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` with `hookEventName: "SubagentStart"`.
events.blocking_guidance: `continue: false` is parsed for compatibility but does not stop the subagent from starting. Use this as context, not a hard gate.

events.name: PreToolUse
events.description: Gate or deny supported tool calls before they run.
events.matcher_guidance: Match the canonical `tool_name` or matcher aliases. Bash uses `Bash`; file edits use canonical `apply_patch` and aliases `Edit` and `Write`; MCP tools use namespaced tool names.
events.output_guidance: Plain text stdout is ignored. JSON can add context with `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext`, deny with `hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision = "deny"` plus `permissionDecisionReason`, or rewrite supported input with `permissionDecision = "allow"` plus `updatedInput`; the legacy `decision: "block"` shape still works.
events.blocking_guidance: Use `deny_pre_tool_use` or exit code `2` with a reason on stderr to block before the tool runs. `permissionDecision: "ask"`, legacy `decision: "approve"`, `continue: false`, `stopReason`, and `suppressOutput` are not supported.

events.name: PermissionRequest
events.description: Answer or deny approval requests before Codex asks the user or guardian approval path.
events.matcher_guidance: Match the tool that is requesting approval. Bash uses `Bash`; file edits use canonical `apply_patch` and aliases `Edit` and `Write`; MCP tools use namespaced tool names when they expose approval payloads.
events.output_guidance: Plain text stdout is ignored. JSON can return `hookSpecificOutput.decision.behavior` as `allow` or `deny`; `deny` may include `message`.
events.blocking_guidance: Any `deny` wins over matching `allow` decisions. Exit code `2` with stderr also denies. Reserved fields such as `updatedInput`, `updatedPermissions`, and `interrupt` are not supported.

events.name: PostToolUse
events.description: React to supported tool results after the tool has already run.
events.matcher_guidance: Match the canonical `tool_name` or matcher aliases. Bash uses `Bash`; file edits use canonical `apply_patch` and aliases `Edit` and `Write`; MCP tools use namespaced tool names.
events.output_guidance: Plain text stdout is ignored. JSON can add context with `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext`, return feedback with `decision: "block"` plus `reason`, or stop normal processing with `continue: false` and optional `stopReason`.
events.blocking_guidance: This event cannot undo side effects. Treat `decision: "block"` or exit code `2` as feedback control, not prevention. `updatedMCPToolOutput` and `suppressOutput` are not supported.

events.name: PreCompact
events.description: Run before manual or automatic conversation compaction and optionally stop the compaction.
events.matcher_guidance: Match the compaction `trigger`. Current values are `manual` and `auto`. `*` and an empty matcher both mean match all.
events.output_guidance: Plain text stdout is ignored. JSON supports common output fields; `continue: false` stops the compaction and `stopReason` supplies the reason.
events.blocking_guidance: `decision: "block"` is not supported for this event. Use `continue: false` when the compaction should not proceed.

events.name: PostCompact
events.description: Run after manual or automatic conversation compaction and optionally stop follow-on processing.
events.matcher_guidance: Match the compaction `trigger`. Current values are `manual` and `auto`. `*` and an empty matcher both mean match all.
events.output_guidance: Plain text stdout is ignored. JSON supports common output fields; `continue: false` stops follow-on processing and `stopReason` supplies the reason.
events.blocking_guidance: `decision: "block"` is not supported for this event. Use `continue: false` if Codex should stop after compaction.

events.name: UserPromptSubmit
events.description: Inject context into user prompts or block a prompt before it is sent.
events.matcher_guidance: Current runtime ignores `matcher` for this event.
events.output_guidance: Plain text stdout is added as extra developer context. JSON can add context with `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` or block with `decision: "block"` and `reason`.
events.blocking_guidance: Use `block_with_reason` or exit code `2` with stderr when Codex should stop and ask for a clearer prompt.

events.name: SubagentStop
events.description: Run subagent completion review or request one more focused subagent pass.
events.matcher_guidance: Match the `agent_type` field. The event also exposes `agent_id`, `agent_transcript_path`, `stop_hook_active`, and `last_assistant_message`.
events.output_guidance: When exiting `0`, stdout must be JSON. JSON supports common output fields and `decision: "block"` plus `reason` to continue the subagent.
events.blocking_guidance: Treat `decision: "block"` as "continue this subagent with the reason as its next prompt". `continue: false` takes precedence over continuation decisions from other matching SubagentStop hooks.

events.name: Stop
events.description: Run end-of-turn review or request one more Codex pass before the turn fully stops.
events.matcher_guidance: Current runtime ignores `matcher` for this event.
events.output_guidance: When exiting `0`, stdout must be JSON. JSON supports common output fields. `decision: "block"` continues Codex with your `reason` as a new continuation prompt.
events.blocking_guidance: Treat `block` on `Stop` as 'continue and do one more pass', not as a normal reject decision. `continue: false` takes precedence over continuation decisions from other matching Stop hooks.
